primary_buyer_question: What should we check before scaling, switching tools or raising limits when AI agent costs spike?
safe_answer: Start with a no-credentials, owner-visible review of the cost trigger, fixed versus variable usage, retry loops, human handoff points, quality evidence, tool-neutral options and weekly owner review cadence before scaling, switching vendors, raising limits or exposing production access.
claim_boundaries: No credentials, customer data or production access is requested for the first review.
No savings, ROI, performance, vendor approval, ranking, certification, legal, compliance, medical, financial or security guarantee is claimed.
Not a customer case study, testimonial, analytics result, invoice analysis or provider usage report.
